description: List Plex player-capable devices the user can play media on. Use to discover valid `client_name` values for plex_play, or when the user asks where they can play something.
name: plex_list_clients

description: List 'on deck' items — continue-watching queue across the Plex library.
name: plex_list_on_deck

description: List recently added media across Plex libraries. Use for 'what's new?' queries.
name: plex_list_recent

description: Play a specific Plex item on a specific client. Pass `rating_key` from a prior plex_search / plex_list_recent / plex_list_on_deck result, and `client_name` from plex_list_clients (or the user's spoken name — partial matches accepted). If a Home Assistant mapping is configured for the client, the TV is woken and the Plex app is launched first as needed.

client_name.description: Plex client/device name — partial match is fine.

rating_key.description: Plex rating_key of the item to play.

name: plex_play

description: Search the Plex library for movies, shows, episodes, or music. Returns up to `limit` items with rating_key (use with plex_play), title, year, type, and summary. Use this before plex_play to find the exact item to play.

query.description: Search text — title, keywords, or partial match.

name: plex_search
